Metadata.title: AirManager

invite.subject: You've been invited to AirManager
invite.body:
Hello,

You've been invited to access AirManager. Set your password within {expiresInDays, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} by visiting the link below:

{url}

If you weren't expecting this invite, you can ignore this email.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your AirManager password
passwordReset.body:
Hello,

You requested to reset your AirManager account password. The link below is valid for {expiresInHours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}:

{url}

If you didn't request this, ignore this email: your current password remains unchanged.

negativeBalanceAlert.subject: Your AirManager account is in the negative
negativeBalanceAlert.body:
Hello {name},

Your AirManager prepaid account balance is now {balance}.

Please contact the airfield office to settle your position.
